H2c.seed_note: one checkpoint seed: the CI excludes seed variability (pre-registration item, STATUS.md §8.3 item 2)

dev_estimation_half.method: (a) analytic: G = ((r z_{1-a} + z_{0.8}) sd / delta)^2, r = SE of the two-stage bootstrap / (sd / sqrt(G_est)); (b) simulation: estimation-half dates resampled to G with the registered two-stage bootstrap, rule and Holm alpha/4
dev_estimation_half.note: TEST dates for 80 % power of the registered test (two-stage date bootstrap, rule, Holm alpha/4); DEV has 2 windows per date, TEST 8 (E1-E4) or the same 4 (E5)

simulation.note: rejection share of the rule and Holm's first step (alpha/4) among simulated experiments

dev_estimation_half.decision_basis: simulated power at G = 16 and the CI bound nearest the null (PREREG §9.4); 24 when below 80%
